tagline.en_US: Chromium is an open-source browser project that aims to build a safer, faster, and more stable way for all users to experience the web.

description.en_US: Chromium is an open-source web browser designed to provide a fast, safe, and stable browsing experience. It serves as the open-source foundation for numerous modern browsers and supports modern web standards and rich web applications. When streamed remotely, it allows users to access a full desktop browser session directly from another web browser.
